nature: Purchase of goods by buyer with turnover > Rs 10 cr in preceding FY
base_rule: TDS only on purchase value exceeding Rs 50 lakh per seller per FY; at earlier of credit or payment; excl. GST if shown separately and TDS on credit, incl. GST on advances (CBDT Circ 13/2021); not applicable if TDS/TCS applies under another provision

nature: Payment to contractor/sub-contractor for work (incl. labour supply)
base_rule: Deduct on whole sum once single sum > 30000 or FY aggregate > 100000; earlier of credit or payment; excl. GST if shown separately (CBDT Circ 23/2017); job work with customer material: excl. material if shown separately; work excludes 194J sums from 2024-10-01

nature: Payment to contractor/sub-contractor for work (incl. labour supply)
base_rule: As 194C individual row; transporter owning <=10 goods carriages furnishing PAN+declaration: no TDS

nature: Fees for technical services (not professional); film royalty; call-centre payee
base_rule: Per category per FY threshold; earlier of credit or payment; excl. GST if shown separately (CBDT Circ 23/2017)

nature: Fees for technical services (not professional); film royalty; call-centre payee
base_rule: Threshold raised 30000->50000 by Finance Act 2025 s.65; per category per FY; excl. GST if shown separately

nature: Fees for professional services; other royalty; non-compete sums
base_rule: Per category per FY; earlier of credit or payment; excl. GST if shown separately (CBDT Circ 23/2017); director remuneration (non-salary) 10% with nil threshold

nature: Fees for professional services; other royalty; non-compete sums
base_rule: Threshold raised 30000->50000 by Finance Act 2025 s.65; director remuneration nil threshold

nature: Rent for plant/machinery/equipment
base_rule: FY aggregate > 240000; earlier of credit or payment; excl. GST if shown separately (CBDT Circ 23/2017)

nature: Rent for plant/machinery/equipment
base_rule: Threshold is per month or part of a month (threshold_single_inr holds the monthly limit), Finance Act 2025 s.64; excl. GST if shown separately

nature: Rent for land, building (incl. factory), furniture, fittings
base_rule: FY aggregate > 240000; earlier of credit or payment; excl. GST if shown separately (CBDT Circ 23/2017)

nature: Rent for land, building (incl. factory), furniture, fittings
base_rule: Threshold is per month or part of a month (threshold_single_inr holds the monthly limit), Finance Act 2025 s.64; excl. GST if shown separately

nature: Commission (not insurance) or brokerage
base_rule: Rate cut 5%->2% from 2024-10-01 (Finance (No.2) Act 2024); FY aggregate > 15000; earlier of credit or payment; excl. GST if shown separately

nature: Commission (not insurance) or brokerage
base_rule: Threshold 15000->20000 by Finance Act 2025 s.63; excl. GST if shown separately

nature: Higher TDS where PAN not furnished or inoperative
base_rule: Higher of section rate, rates in force, or 20% (5% for 194Q and 194-O); inoperative PAN (rule 114AAA, CBDT Circ 3/2023) treated as no PAN from 2023-07-01, subject to relief Circ 6/2024 and 9/2025

nature: Higher TDS for specified-person non-filers of ITR
base_rule: Higher of twice the section rate, twice the rate in force, or 5% (rate formula per secondary sources); omitted by Finance Act 2025 s.71

nature: TCS by seller (turnover > Rs 10 cr) on sale of goods (not TDS; for reference)
base_rule: 0.1% of receipts exceeding Rs 50 lakh per buyer per FY; not applicable where buyer deducted TDS (194Q); omitted from 2025-04-01 by Finance Act 2025 s.72(c)

nature: Purchase of any goods by a buyer (s.402(6): turnover > Rs 10 cr in preceding tax year)
base_rule: Note 1(b): TDS on sum exceeding Rs 50 lakh; Note 1(a): not where TDS/TCS applies under another provision; earlier of credit or payment (s.393(1)(c)); GST treatment per Circ 13/2021 continued by s.536(2)(j)

nature: Work contract incl. supply of labour (and supply of manpower from 2026-04-01 via Finance Act 2026) paid by designated person
base_rule: Deduct on entire amount once threshold exceeded (s.393(1)(a)); earlier of credit or payment; s.402(47)(e) customer-material job work: excl. material if shown separately; excl. GST if shown separately (Circ 23/2017 via s.536(2)(j)); s.393(4) Sl.8 transporter (<=10 carriages) exempt

nature: Work contract incl. supply of labour (and supply of manpower from 2026-04-01) paid by designated person
base_rule: As above

nature: Fees for technical services (not professional); film royalty; payee only in call-centre business
base_rule: Threshold 50000 for each of (a) professional fees (b) FTS (d) royalty (e) s.26(2)(h) sums; entire amount once exceeded; earlier of credit or payment; excl. GST if shown separately

nature: Fees for professional services; royalty (other); s.26(2)(h) sums; director fees (nil threshold)
base_rule: Director remuneration (6(iii)(c)) threshold Nil; others 50000; excl. GST if shown separately

nature: Rent for machinery/plant/equipment
base_rule: Threshold is 50000 for a month or part of a month (threshold_single_inr holds the monthly limit); entire amount once exceeded; excl. GST if shown separately

nature: Rent for land, building (incl. factory building), appurtenant land, furniture, fittings
base_rule: Threshold is 50000 for a month or part of a month (threshold_single_inr holds the monthly limit); excl. GST if shown separately

nature: Commission (not insurance commission) or brokerage
base_rule: Entire amount once FY aggregate > 20000; earlier of credit or payment; excl. GST if shown separately

nature: Higher TDS where valid PAN not furnished
base_rule: Higher of (A) rate in Act, (B) rates in force, (C) 5% for Sl. 8(ii)/8(v) else 20%; PAN inoperative under s.262(6)(b) if Aadhaar not intimated (treatment as no PAN not traced in new Act)
